## Requirements (spec contract, re-extracted)

1. `scripts/rename-crates.sh` — BEFORE touching any file: crates.io availability
   check over the exact publish set — every `cargo metadata --no-deps` publishable
   `hh-<x>` → `hharness-<x>` + umbrella `hharness`; one
   `GET https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/<name>` per name, descriptive UA, ≥1 s
   apart; 404=free, 200=taken, else inconclusive. Any taken/inconclusive → STOP,
   non-zero exit, no partial rename. Dated per-name output recorded verbatim here.
2. Then — idempotent, deterministic — rewrite manifests, dependency keys,
   `use`/path references, scripts, workflows, codegen inputs; regenerate generated
   artifacts.
3. ADR — rename mechanics: (a) lib names (default = package name vs `[lib] name`),
   (b) directories (default keep `crates/hh-*`), (c) binaries unchanged, (d) env
   vars `HH_*` + wire/schema ids unchanged (contract names, not crate names).
4. OQ-068 `_meta` code-constant conform (R4.15a surfacing): interim
   `dev.cognition/*` `_meta` keys + the `_meta.hh` member → `hharness/…` per the
   ADR-0210 amendment-log allocation record (byte-faithful). Wire-stability
   posture named.
5. Living docs (README, AGENTS.md, crates/AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING, MAINTAINING) to
   the new names; build records untouched (append-only).
6. Full verification: fmt, build, test, drift, removability, xcheck-foreign —
   all green; generated client + schema regenerate cleanly.
7. Universal phase-gate AC: tests for new behavior, requirement ids stamped,
   ADR(s), BUILD_INDEX row, LEDGER advance, clock dates, ci-boundary read.

## Acceptance criteria

rename (stays HarnessHarness).

## Plan

1. Write `scripts/rename-crates.sh` (availability gate → mechanical rewrite →
   regeneration) + `scripts/ci/test-rename-crates.sh` (stubbed-answers fixture
   test: `taken` → exit≠0/no touches, `inconclusive` → exit≠0, all-404 → renames,
   re-run → idempotent).
2. Rename decisions (to be recorded in the ADR): lib names = package default
   (`hharness_<x>`, `use` paths rewritten); directories keep `crates/hh-*`;
   binaries/env vars/wire+schema+product ids (`hh-kernel/<ver>` etc.) unchanged;
   spikes/ left frozen (throwaway measurement trees, excluded from workspace).
3. `_meta` conform: `dev.cognition/hir`→`hharness/hir`,
   `dev.cognition/propagation`→`hharness/propagation`,
   `dev.cognition/input_required`→`hharness/input_required`, ACP `_meta` vendor
   member `hh`→`hharness` (inner members `source_seq`/`agent_semantic_id`/
   `hh_methods`/`request_kinds`/`update_kinds`/`protocol_pin`/carrier members
   unchanged; `hh` tracestate member, `hh.*` baggage/OTLP, `hh/` registry
   namespace, `_hh/` methods, `hh://` scheme all stay per the record).
4. Run the script → rename → regenerate (codegen, lockfile, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES,
   fmt) → audit leftover `hh-` tokens → hand-fix living docs.
5. ADR-0379 (rename mechanics), full verification battery, PR, closeout.

## Sweep corrections (script bugs surfaced by verification, then fixed)

| Bug | Symptom | Fix in `rename-crates.sh` |
|---|---|---|
| `$( )`-nested heredoc + apostrophe | shell parse error (bash quirk) | map via temp files, top-level heredocs |
| `python3 -` stdin collision | empty `sys.stdin` for cargo JSON | cargo JSON staged to temp file |
| TOML `section=None` | crash on header-less TOML | `(section or "").endswith(...)` |
| `'` path-string matcher | apostrophes in prose swallowed files | dropped; boundaries + path-API args |
| `..hh_x::` spread blocked | struct-update sites missed | `..` exempted in lib left boundary |
| `hh-x:`/`x:hh-y`/`.hh-z` spellings | wire/log/holder/file tokens renamed | `:` and `.` added to token boundaries |
| `.join("hh-x")` dir basename | codegen emitted to a new `crates/hharness-*` dir | path-API arg protection over the crate/plugin DIRSET |
| `realm="hh-x"` | OAuth realm wire values renamed | `realm=` context protection |

## Decisions (ADR-0379)

- Packages `hh-<x>` → `hharness-<x>`; Rust libs `hh_<x>` → `hharness_<x>`.
- Directories stay `crates/hh-*`/`plugins/hh-*` (append-only provenance).
- Binaries unchanged (`hh`, `hh-kernel`, `hh-helper`, `hh-mcp-serve`,
  `hh-codegen`, `hh-compile`, `hh-xcheck`, packaged-variant bins, …).
- Contract spellings byte-frozen: `hh-embed/1`, `hh-kernel/<ver>`,
  `hh-helper/1`, `hh://`, `hh/` namespace, `_hh/` methods, `hh.*`
  attributes, `HH_*` env vars, `hh` tracestate member, log/holder
  spellings (`hh-bundle:<ver>`, `hh-embed:fleet`, `otel.service:hh-bundle`,
  `realm="hh-lab"`).
- OQ-068 `_meta` conform per ADR-0210: `dev.cognition/*` → `hharness/*`
  (`hir`, `propagation`, `input_required`); ACP `_meta.hh` →
  `_meta.hharness` (member tuple + `.get/.get_mut/.insert` + accessor).
- `hh-embed/1` `owner_layer` debt metadata names the crate →
  `hharness-embed`; the honest `schema_hash` roll is carried by the
  regenerated matrix + TS `EXPECTED_SCHEMA_HASH` (CC7, one step).
